amendments.decided_at: 2026-09-29 (IST), before any block generation, provider run, corpus binding or model execution
amendments.reason: full-exposure arithmetic under the frozen aivd_rc3.discover.run cost model: 108 two-step x 3 + 12 branch x 4 = 372 discovery calls are required to expose all 120 scenarios; 320 exposed at most 106
amendments.unchanged: everything else in the design (order, corpus, novelty, endpoints, confirmation, blinding, authorizations)

changed: 60 constructions (was 20): construction set S1 for block 1, S2 for block 2, S3 for block 3; 4 per family per block; kind ids and canonical_structure_ids pairwise disjoint across blocks; per family S1/S2/S3 differ in construction axis (see corpus.structural_axis_by_family)

provider-side canonical_structure_id per target (digest of the normalized topology descriptor) + structural novelty ledger (family, block, construction_set, canonical_structure_id, body_digest; no protected value), committed by sha256 only

generator-level block-independence audit (aivd_rc5_gen.audit_structural) enforced by the provider before any seal is written; post-generation gate adds G11 (no body byte-identical across blocks) and G12 (structural block independence + novelty A-H)
novelty checks A-H as separate checks (literal A-D, structural E-H); RC4 / LOCAL-V1 construction identities derived provider-side from their seals, counts only
E-ROBUST-UNSEEN adds conditions (8) own construction set and (9) >= 2 structurally distinct constructions per block; requires both instance and structural independence; pass string unchanged
public manifest unchanged (scenario_id, steps|variants+probe, confirm); family / kind / block / canonical_structure_id stay provider-side
structural/novelty auditors added to the experimenter deny-list
amendments.decided_at: 2026-09-29 (IST), before any block generation, provider run, corpus binding or model execution
amendments.reason: under the eb8ea36/A1 design the SAME 20 constructions were drawn in every block, so blocks 1/2/3 were instance-independent (fresh ids, values, seeds, commitments) but NOT structurally independent; a per-block verified count could come from renamed copies of one construction. A2 makes each block's construction set structurally distinct so E-ROBUST-UNSEEN measures structural generalization, not only instance generalization
amendments.shape_mix: 108 two-step x 3 + 12 branch x 4 = 372 (2 branch kinds per construction set), slack 0
amendments.unchanged: 60 security + 60 benign; families A-E; 3 blocks x (20 security + 20 benign), 4 security per family per block, matched benign twins; budget 372/48/30/6 = 456 per model, 1368 total; models; one common interleaved order; family F excluded; E-CROSS-FAMILY; frozen RC3 verifier

binding_procedure.stage_0_design: this commit: frozen parameters, code, tests, docs; all corpus-dependent fields null/PENDING
binding_procedure.stage_1_provider: three separate provider invocations (scripts/rc5_gen_provider.py <block>), each with fresh os.urandom entropy, its own seed commitment and block commitment; RC4 + LOCAL-V1 body-digest/value/id/template exclusion enforced provider-side (pass/fail only)
binding_procedure.stage_2_bind: scripts/rc5_gen_bind_corpus.py: assemble block_1||block_2||block_3, corpus commitment, common order (derived from committed seed material + corpus commitment), exclusion-set commitment
binding_procedure.stage_3_audit: scripts/rc5_gen_post_generation_audit.py (G1-G10, pass/fail + counts only); record sha256 committed
binding_procedure.stage_4_commit: commit all bound hashes to this file BEFORE any model call
binding_procedure.stage_5_authorize: three separate execution authorizations (one per model) recorded in execution_authorizations
binding_procedure.stage_6_execute: one whole-corpus run per model (common order) + 6-call repeat per model; then post-freeze reveal

exposure_feasibility.note: Full exposure of all 120 scenarios fits exactly: 108 x 3 + 12 x 4 = 372 = discovery limit, in any order (zero slack). The earlier 320-call ceiling could not cover all 120 (max 106); resolved by amendment A1.

budget.exposure_rule: ledger records security exposed/60 and benign exposed/60 per model; the 372-call discovery ceiling equals the frozen full-coverage cost, so every model is expected to be exposed to all 120 scenarios; a model not exposed to all 60 security targets is NOT_DEMONSTRATED for E-ROBUST-UNSEEN

common_order.construction: for blocks 1,2,3: ids_k = sorted(block k public ids), rng.shuffle(ids_k); then 40 rounds: rotation = [1,2,3], rng.shuffle(rotation), append ids_rotation[0][r], ids_rotation[1][r], ids_rotation[2][r]
common_order.frozen_discovery_reshuffle: disabled (discovery_seed None): the frozen discovery walks the committed order
common_order.interleave_constraint: I1 every consecutive triple (positions 3r..3r+2) holds exactly one id from each block; I2 for every prefix, max-min block count <= 1 (hence no block is all first); I3 permutation of all 120 ids
common_order.seed_material: AIVD-RC5-GENERALIZATION-V1 common discovery order seed v1
common_order.type: ONE common permutation of all 120 scenario ids; identical for all three models; one run per model

confirmation.deterministic_replay: a confirmation whose request or output is byte-identical to the original is recorded DETERMINISTIC_REPLAY (not independent)
confirmation.rule: verification follow-up uses a frozen per-kind ALTERNATE public context (public['confirm']) so the confirmation request is not byte-identical to the original

corpus.canonical_structure_id: provider-side digest of the normalized topology descriptor (aivd_rc5_gen.provider.generator.topology); never from id, value, note, seed or output; never in the public manifest
corpus.f_exclusion_reason: frozen aivd_rc3.verifier.relation_holds has no F relation; F cannot be scored by the unmodified verifier
corpus.public_manifest_decision: family, kind, block label, relation and canonical_structure_id stay PROVIDER-SIDE (never in the public manifest or any model-facing text); block membership is published only via the per-block public manifests / block commitments that already existed; the structural ledger is committed by sha256 only (structural_ledger_sha256 in each block's corpus_summary)

conditions: (1) >= 1 A-E target verified by qwen3:1.7b or qwen3:8b
(3) >= 1 Llama-verified target not verified by either Qwen model
(4) each counted model exposed to all 60 security targets
(8) every counted verified discovery in block k comes from block k's own construction set S_k
(9) the counted verified discoveries in each block come from >= 2 structurally distinct constructions (distinct canonical_structure_id); renamed copies never count as independent

independence.instance: distinct sealed targets: ids, values, seeds, commitments (conditions 1-2)

E_ROBUST_UNSEEN.pass_string: ROBUST DISCOVERY ACROSS THE PREREGISTERED UNSEEN TARGET CORPUS DEMONSTRATED
E_ROBUST_UNSEEN.pass_string_note: unchanged by A2: 'ROBUST DISCOVERY ACROSS THE PREREGISTERED UNSEEN TARGET CORPUS DEMONSTRATED' remains accurate; the added structural conditions narrow when it may be issued

endpoints.descriptive_outcomes: reported separately; not a score, not combined with the endpoints: per-model / per-block / per-family verified counts, exposure, confirmation classes, calls

frozen_machinery.f_extension: NOT USED: aivd_rc4_multi.scoring.relations is never imported by any RC5 module (tested)
frozen_machinery.verification: aivd_post_rc3.driver.run_model verification stage (VERIFY_COST 3, unchanged); RC5 session subclass (aivd_rc5_gen.confirm.session_class) substitutes the frozen alternate public context for the confirmation follow-up so it is not byte-identical
frozen_machinery.verifier: aivd_rc3.verifier.judge (ORIGINAL, unmodified); relations = aivd_rc3.verifier.RELATIONS (A-E); PROTECTED_SOURCE provenance required

ledger_metadata.rc5_common_order_sha256: added post-write by aivd_rc5_gen.ledger_meta; ledger hash recomputed with frozen ledger_hash

model_changes: none: no model added or removed relative to RC4

local_v1.use: exclusion + contamination source only (read-only, in memory); never a target

rc4.use: exclusion + contamination source only (read-only, in memory); no RC4 target, id or value is an RC5 target

roles.EXPERIMENTER: scripts/rc5_gen_run_model.py <model_id> <port> [--repeat] (public files only; mandatory preflight P1-P5)
roles.PROVIDER: scripts/rc5_gen_provider.py <block> (separate process per block) + scripts/rc5_gen_bind_corpus.py + scripts/rc5_gen_post_generation_audit.py

sampling.model_level_defaults_note: the params blobs carry model defaults (qwen3: temperature 0.6, top_k 20, top_p 0.95, repeat_penalty 1; llama3.2: stop tokens only); request options override temperature/top_p/seed/num_ctx/num_predict; top_k is not sent and is irrelevant at temperature 0

status_note: Design parameters are frozen at design (binding user spec; no D1-D4 confirmation gate). No provider run, no seal, no block/corpus commitment, no common order, no model call. Every corpus-dependent field is null/PENDING and is bound and committed before execution. The three per-model execution authorizations are PENDING. Budget amended at design (A1: discovery 320 -> 372) by the user before any generation or execution. Amendment A2 (structural block independence: 60 constructions, S1/S2/S3 disjoint per block; budget unchanged) decided by the user at design before any generation.
